svg.title: How a multi-part request becomes rows
svg.desc: Contract 3: a request becomes a bounded plan. The phone then filters, explains and sorts its own copy of the inventory. Nothing is saved and no stock changes.
svg.text: Multi-part requests: plan, then deterministic rows (contract 3)
Understood on the phone when every word is a known filter; otherwise Groq returns a plan that the server checks. The same executor runs both. Example: “Low-stock wound-care items
from supplier Good Supplier, excluding gloves, sorted alphabetically.”
You say or type, then Send
Reviewed words only. Nothing is understood or fetched
Comparisons, stock states, critical, category, supplier,
brand, exclusions, sorting, follow-ups and drafts.
Groq plan · only if chosen and consented
Strict schema plus lexical checks: names, signs,
comparisons, filters, critical polarity, groups and
fail closed; arbitrary meaning is not guaranteed.
any_of: [ low stock AND category “Wound care” AND supplier “Good Supplier” ]
exclude: [ name contains “gloves” ] sort: A–Z scope: all active items
Draft plans add explicit lines (set / add / remove) and include_selection for suggested quantities.
All active items, or the list
Every condition in a group must
Rows from any group, each item
once by ID. Every reason it
Filters understood · quantity with unit · status icon +
text · a Why line per row · one-tap refinements that
exclusion → clarify all. Others show Suggested plus
basis. Missing minimum → ask. Existing work → Merge,
Unclear or near-spelled names, “critical” versus a
category named critical, a partly said supplier, or a
follow-up with no list on screen.
Voice setup keeps four things apart
verify, not proof of live sound. Never
replies, stored for this account only.
Old choices load with no online opt-in.
The saved choice if it is ready.
